title: InboxMessage/SentMessage drop spec ts; firmware keys only
description:
File: rust/lichen-client/src/msg.rs (InboxMessage, SentMessage, Inbox::from_cbor)

Crate and module docs claim the firmware contract and spec 18.1 / 17.5.7. The typed GET decoders do not:

- Spec 18.1.2 inbox element: {id, from, ts, body}
- LCI 17.5.7 received is an ISO-8601 string
- Firmware coap_msg.c encode_inbox_cbor: {id, from, body, received} as Unix uint
- Firmware sent records: {id, to, body, timestamp, status}

InboxMessage only has received: u64 (default 0). A spec-shaped map with ts is accepted and ts is dropped, so received is 0. Python lichen.client.lci.normalize_message reads received as a string and timestamp from ts/t.

Same-module MessagesStore::get_inbox() returns the stored POST map (ts if the client sent it, never received). inbox_get_includes_unread then decodes that payload with Inbox::from_cbor, so timestamps are lost even in-process.

SentMessage uses timestamp, not spec ts, with the same silent drop.

Fix: alias ts and timestamp onto the time field; keep received as uint for firmware; reject or separately parse LCI ISO received rather than defaulting to 0.

Perspectives: correctness.
